layout_sources: https://lifeafter40.net/convert-truist-transaction-file-to-suntrust-file-format-excel-macro-to-reformat-truist-to-suntrust-layout/ (Truist's file has a single Amount column with withdrawals negative, unlike SunTrust's two)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/master/bank2ynab.conf ([US BB&T], issue #115: EXPORT.CSV, six columns with date first, description fourth, one amount fifth)
https://capyparse.com/blog/convert-truist-bank-statement-to-csv-excel-qbo (Posted Date and Transaction Date both present; layout changed in late 2025, adding Full description and Merchant name)
notes: Header from memory of the 2022-2025 Truist export: Posted Date,Transaction Date,Transaction Type,Check/Serial #,Description,Amount,Daily Posted Balance; only the two dates and the single signed Amount (withdrawals negative) are confirmed. Truist reportedly changed the layout in late 2025 (Full description, Merchant name, Category name columns), not reflected here. Newest first, MM/DD/YYYY, no quoting or thousands separator, LF assumed. One line a day, so Daily Posted Balance is the balance after each line: opening is the oldest less its amount, closing the newest. Lines dated by Transaction Date.
